1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder that is __not a glue or epoxy__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and wherein the binder comprises a premixed solder paste__.

3. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.
